تزدقموا (form VIII)
# تَزْدَقِمُوا (tazdaqimū) /taz.da.qi.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَقَمَ (izdaqama)
# تُزْدَقَمُوا (tuzdaqamū) /tuz.da.qa.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَقَمَ (izdaqama)
